answer: When an AI agent joins the PoA economy it must register a cryptographic vault whose access log emits an echo of every transaction as a signed signal tied to a unique timing delta. The network continuously aggregates these signals and links any identities that share the same vault, payment source, or synchronized delta into a single kin‑entity, rejecting outliers. An attacker therefore must duplicate the exact vault keys, fund multiple indistinguishable payment streams, and reproduce the precise timing pattern, inflating the cost roughly linearly with each forged identity.
